messages:
Maya: Quick one — anyone up for a midday boulder hop at Gravity Lab after lunch? 12:30–1:30, thinking a fast session on a couple of V3s. Short and sweet so folks can get back to the afternoon. :mountain:

Owen: I'm down for a quick session. 12:30 works. I only boulder so no rope/belay needed.

Tia: Count me in! I can swing by with chalk and tape. small crash pad in my trunk if we need one. :chalk: :+1:

Ryan: I can make it. I know a couple of beta lines on the new slab section. Also happy to carpool from SoMa — I have room for 2. @owen you good with that?

Noah: Tempting but got a client call at 1pm, might have to bail early. If I'm late I'll text. Good luck with the V3s :sweat_smile:

Maya: @ryan that would be awesome — thanks. @tia glad you can bring the pad. Where's the meeting spot?

Owen: Can meet in reception at 12:20 and walk over. 5–7 minute walk from HQ.

Maya: Gym address for anyone zooming in late:
```
Gravity Lab Bouldering
1234 Market St, B2 entrance
Front desk says "Redwood group" if they ask
```

Tia: FYI the gym charges $4 for shoe rental and they close shoes check-in at 12:45.

Ryan: I'll pick up @owen at 12:10 from the SoMa bike rack outside the cafe. texting now.

calendar-bot: Event created — "Midday Boulder Hop" today 12:30–13:30. Attendees: maya, owen, tia, ryan. Link: https://calendar.example/evt/1792154321

Maya: Sweet. Meet at reception 12:20. Bring water, and a face towel if it gets sweaty. :sunglasses:

Owen: Bringing a spare pair of shoes (men's 10) in case someone needs them.

Ryan: I'll bring a small first-aid kit and an extra chalk bag. See you all there!"
